cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check newest log file
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /var/log/areloria/")
print("=== Log Files ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -20 /var/log/areloria/out-0.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'no output log'")
print("\n=== Output Log ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -20 /var/log/areloria/error-0.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'no error log'")
print("\n=== Error Log ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
PYEOF
